adversarials.behavior: The car approaches from the right along the main road and executes a left-hand turn into the vertical side street, creating a conflicting path with the ego vehicle.
The car follows directly behind the ego vehicle along the main road.
The car trails behind the primary adversarial car along the main road.

requirements_and_restrictions: Initial distances to the T-junction are defined for all four vehicles, and the scenario terminates once the ego vehicle has completed its right-hand turn and resolved the conflict with the primary adversarial vehicle.
